General info about remote access of computers

depending on your capabilities and your budget, it can be as simple as tricking someone to download some file and instal it.

these were leaked from a company which develops a software called FinFisher https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oNsXKPHBR3s

One thing to understand is how these things get past firewall rules. Most setups allow a computer to make an outbound connection anywhere, while typically blocking most inbound connections. To be able to connect remotely to a firewalled computer you need to initiate a 'back connect'.

Ie; Somehow trick target into executing a malicious tool, which starts a service on port 1337.
You try to connect to the device, but you are firewalled. That's a problem.

Instead, you program the malware to connect to the outside world, eg; the attackers C&C server on port 1337.

As long as the software installed by the attacker has permissions to access audio input and/or camera input, they can send snapshots or stream audio over this connection or install more malware etc. They would have access to anything the user which has been infected does. It could be limited, but most attackers will try to elevate their privileges to take full control of the system.
